item.title: Master carver to engrave crystals from last year's New Year's Eve ball sold as mementos
item.description: People who find themselves at the site of the iconic New Year's Eve ball drop can purchase one of the 5,280 Waterford crystals from the Constellation Ball that dropped in New York City last year in honor of the nation's 250th birthday in 2026.

item.title: Scott Colom makes history in Mississippi. Two other Black men did the same 150 years before him
item.description: When Scott Colom is sworn into the U.S. Senate in January, he will not be the first Black senator from Mississippi to make history.

item.title: Is Outlook down? Widespread outage hits Microsoft apps
item.description: A widespread outage hit Microsoft platforms including Outlook on Thursday, with many users encountering trouble using their email accounts and other errors across the tech giant’s suite of apps.

item.title: CDC eliminates $29 million for HIV prevention in Texas
item.description: The federal government has cut $29.2 million from Texas health organizations that test thousands of people for HIV directly in their communities, the latest in a series of public health funding cuts statewide.

item.title: What we know after Jensen Huang resigns as Nvidia's CEO
item.description: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has resigned from his top post at the chipmaker he co-founded, after reports of the tech titan’s extramarital affairs came into the spotlight this week.
